1. [DATA LOADING] Load MovieLens100K, Amazon2014VideoGames, and HetrecLastFM datasets using OmniRec's RecSysDataSet.use_dataloader().

2. [PREPROCESSING - IMPLICIT CONVERSION] For MovieLens100K and Amazon2014VideoGames only, convert explicit ratings to implicit feedback using MakeImplicit(3) (keep ratings >= 3). HetrecLastFM is already implicit and must NOT be converted.

3. [PREPROCESSING - CORE PRUNING] Apply 5-core pruning (CorePruning(5)) to all three datasets to remove users/items with fewer than 5 interactions. Apply this AFTER implicit conversion (for applicable datasets).
4. [RANDOM SEEDS] Generate exactly 5 different random seeds for data splitting. Use set_random_state(seed) before each split to ensure reproducibility.
5. [DATA SPLITTING - USER HOLDOUT] For each dataset and seed, perform a user-based holdout using UserHoldout(validation_size=0, test_size=0.2), producing an 80/20 train/test split per user.

6. [ALGORITHM SELECTION] Use exactly three LensKit algorithms via OmniRec: LensKit.ImplicitMFScorer (ALS), LensKit.ItemKNNScorer (ItemKNN), and LensKit.PopScorer (Popularity). Configure all with feedback='implicit'.
7. [EXPERIMENT EXECUTION] Execute all combinations (3 datasets × 3 algorithms × 5 seeds = 45 conditions) using run_omnirec() with an ExperimentPlan. Each seed's split must be applied independently.
8. [EVALUATION METRICS] Evaluate all models using nDCG@k and Precision@k for k=1, 5, 10 via the OmniRec Evaluator.

9. [STATISTICAL ANALYSIS] For each (dataset, algorithm, metric, k) combination, report the mean and standard deviation of metric values across the 5 seeds to quantify variance due to random data splits.
